reviews.comment: Came in, having read the material, still not understanding it. That's alright, they always lecture over the material and take the quiz in small group, as stated in the sylly. Nah. She crashes out that a couple kids didn't read and makes us take a pop quiz about tough legal topics and then doesn't teach any of the material after. great way to teach.

Do not recommend. She is the most annoying person I have ever met. She overloads you with work on top of estimating and does not care. Picks you out in class to explain cases. All the other professors are extremely easy for this class, and she does not care. 8 assignments a week average all random busy work. Grades extremely hard.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: This is a great class. Prof. D does a good job of explaining the cases/readings so that everyone can succeed. Exams are easy if you participate in lectures/HW. Good class to take with Estimating 2. Much better option than MEP.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: If you can take one of the other law professors you should. The hardest thing for me in this class is her extensive use of instruction for assignments and papers, and then she grades you on how closely you match her particular style. Instead of having a defined guideline for students, there is room for misinterpretation that can hinder your grade.

Insane amount of busy work that burns out students and they are completely unnecessary. The other law professors do not assign any of this pointless work. She grades assignments incredibly hard and gives awful feedback, more so berating your writing instead of telling you how to make it better. Very frustrating professor to deal with. Do not take.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Very helpful techniques to help students gain law understanding. I grasped the concepts because of Professor Daigneault.

She gives an enormous amount of busy work that will have you wanting to pull your hair out. I worked tirelessly to receive a good grade while other sections were receiving an easy A, learning the same amount of material. She runs her classroom like we are in 1st grade and shows no respect. She is rude and has no understanding for your situation
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Professor D. has been one of my favorite proffesors so far. Her grading standards are more difficult than the other professors, but I learned more from her than those that took the other professors. There is a small assignment due at the beginning of every class, but they are quite easy and she drops 2-4 of them depending on class participation.

Prof D gives A LOT of homework (at least 3 assignments a week) but it sorta cancels out because we didn't have exams this sem. She gives random in-class quizzes or assignments so attendance matters. She seems really mean but if you participate in class, she will be way nicer and is more likely to drop assignments. Prob wouldn't take again tbh.

Professor D is a great person. she looks at you as a person & not a student that is under her. if there is a problem and you talk with her before the issue&have a good reason she 9/10 understood&worked to allow you to get full credit. lots of busy work but she drops 3or4 of your lowest grades which helps a lot. also extra credit opportunity.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: So much work compared to the other law profs she deserves a 1 solely for that. I'd recommend the other law profs for that exact reason so you don't have to do assignments on a weekly basis. Take Ellis or Grisham and you'll save yourself a lot of busy work.

Mrs. Daigneault is a very good professor. She actually graduated from COSC and went to law school, she will teach you what you need to be ready for the construction industry. Get ready to read and write FIRACS. However, she will help you as much as you need, she dropped the lowest 3 FIRAC's to help us out. She is always willing to help you.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Worst professor in COSC. If it weren't for the absurd about of assignments, you may feel like you are in kindergarten because of the way she runs her classroom. She demands respect, but does not give any to her students. Do not take her under any circumstances.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Group projects--So many papers

reviews.comment: This class is so difficult to take when you take the normal work load that a COSC major takes at this time of their time as a student at TAMU. Take one of the other professors they will make your life easier and get a better grade in the class. Ts and Gs
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: DO NOT LISTEN TO THESE TWO COMMENTS BELOW THEY ARE LIES. Daigneault is an awful professor. We are 9 weeks into the semester & we have not gone into a lecture that she has actually taught in. Grading rubric is 0-10 but she only gives out 5,8,10 she grades extremely hard and no feedback. She does not explain anything in class pertaining to the class.

Prof. D is very knowledgeable in construction law and knows how to dumb things down to get students to understand. She is strict with deadlines and requirements, yet considerate and reasonable. Expect at least 2 assignments a week. Not an easy class, but you will learn a lot if you put in the effort.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Melissa Daigneault is a great professor. This class is difficult but you can do well if you show up and read the book. People who did poorly in this class were the students who did not show up or left early. The content of construction law can be deep and hard to understand but Professor Daigneault does a great job of teaching it.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--EXTRA CREDIT
